strings.BACKUP_BATTERY: Battery saving can stop this phone backing up while Centraid is closed.
strings.BACKUP_BATTERY_ACTION: Let Centraid back up in the background
strings.BACKUP_FORGET_FAILED: Centraid could not forget {name}. Try again.
strings.BACKUP_FORGOTTEN_NOT_REVOKED: This phone no longer backs up to {name}. Your laptop could not be told: revoke this phone there with “centraid-gateway pairings revoke”.
strings.BACKUP_FORGOTTEN_REVOKED: This phone no longer backs up to {name}. Your laptop will refuse this phone from now on.
strings.BACKUP_LINE_FROZEN: This vault moved to another phone. This phone is read-only.
strings.BACKUP_LINE_UNPAIRED: Not backed up. Pair a laptop to keep a copy of this vault.
strings.BACKUP_WAIT_ASK: {count} waiting for you to tap Back up now
strings.BACKUP_WAIT_UNTRUSTED: {count} waiting: the machine that answered is not your laptop
strings.BACKUP_WAIT_WINDOW: {count} waiting for time in the background
strings.FETCH_DAMAGED: The copy on your laptop did not open, so the original did not come back.
strings.FETCH_NOT_IN_BACKUP: Your laptop does not hold this original, so it cannot come back from there.
strings.FETCH_NO_ANSWER: Centraid could not bring the original back. Try again.
strings.FETCH_UNREACHABLE: Centraid could not reach your laptop, so the original did not come back. Try again when this phone can reach it.
strings.FETCH_UNTRUSTED: The machine that answered is not your laptop, so Centraid took nothing from it.
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_BODY: Your vault lives on this phone. Nothing leaves it unless you say so.
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_HOUSE_TITLE: Everything in one place, on this phone
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_HOUSE_BODY: Photos, notes, documents and money live here, with no account to make.
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_KEY_BODY: Write them down once, and they bring your vault back on a new phone.
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_COPY_TITLE: Your laptop keeps a sealed copy
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_COPY_BODY: Pair one when you are ready; it holds the copy and cannot open it.
strings.FIRST_LAUNCH_MAKE: Make a vault on this phone
strings.HOME_DAY_ONE_BODY: Bring your photographs and documents in and this becomes the front of your own archive.
strings.HOME_PHOTOS_ABSENT: These photographs are not on this device yet.
strings.SAMPLE_LINE: A sample vault is here to look around in. Remove it when you are done.
strings.SAMPLE_NO_PAIR: Switch to your own vault to pair a laptop.
strings.SAMPLE_REMOVE_BODY: This deletes the sample vault and leaves your own vault as it is.
strings.STRANDED_WRITE: Your last change in {app} was not saved.
strings.TRASH_EMPTY_BODY: Everything in trash leaves this vault for good. This cannot be undone.
strings.TRASH_EMPTY_STATE_BODY: Deleted things wait here before they go for good.
strings.TRASH_PURGE_BODY: It leaves this vault for good. This cannot be undone.
strings.VAULTS_FORGET_BODY: This deletes the vault and everything in it from this phone. A laptop it backs up to keeps its copy, and your 24 words bring it back from there; without one, there is no other copy.
strings.VAULTS_MAKE_SPOKEN: Make a vault on this phone
